    "  // 3D Studio PMREM-Style Environment Reflection (Overhead Softbox + Key Strip + Horizon Rim)",
    "  vec3 R = reflect(-V, N);",
    "  float softbox = smoothstep(-0.2, 0.85, R.y) * (0.55 + 0.45 * cos(R.x * 3.5));",
    "  float keyStrip = exp(-length(R.xy - L.xy * 0.65) * 2.4);",
    "  float rimKick = pow(1.0 - NdotV, 2.6);",
    "  vec3 envLight = F0 * (0.28 * softbox + 0.52 * keyStrip + 0.25 * rimKick) * (1.0 - rough * 0.52);",
    "  return diff + spec * 1.15 + envLight;",
    "}",
    "// --- V6 FUTURISTIC HOLLYWOOD IMAX / THX 3D RAYMARCHED ARCHITECTURE & 12-SLICE EXTRUSION ENGINE ---",
    "vec3 world3DPass(vec2 p, float t, vec3 wCol, vec3 F0, vec3 subCol, float archMode){",
    "  float tImp = 1.65;",
    "  float dolly = t * 1.35 + smoothstep(tImp - 0.15, tImp + 0.35, t) * 0.65;",
    "  float roll = 0.035 * sin(t * 0.55) + 0.022 * exp(-max(0.0, t - tImp) * 5.0) * sin((t - tImp) * 32.0);",
    "  vec2 q = rot2(p, roll);",
    "  vec3 ro = vec3(0.10 * sin(t * 0.42), 0.05 * cos(t * 0.36), dolly);",
    "  vec3 rd = normalize(vec3(q * 1.18, 1.42));",
    "  float totalD = 0.0, glowAcc = 0.0, edgeAcc = 0.0, hit = 0.0;",
    "  vec3 hitPos = ro;",
    "  for(int i = 0; i < 16; i++){",
    "    vec3 pos = ro + rd * totalD;",
    "    float d = 10.0;",
    "    if(archMode < 0.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos; rp.x = abs(rp.x) - 1.32; rp.z = mod(rp.z + 0.7, 1.4) - 0.7;",
    "      float cyl = length(rp.xz) - 0.23 + 0.018 * cos(atan(rp.z, rp.x) * 16.0);",
    "      float cap = max(abs(pos.y) - 0.76, length(rp.xz) - 0.33);",
    "      float flCeil = 0.88 - abs(pos.y) + 0.025 * cos(pos.x * 8.0) * cos(pos.z * 8.0);",
    "      d = min(min(cyl, cap), flCeil);",
    "    } else if(archMode < 1.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos; rp.x = abs(rp.x) - 1.26; rp.z = mod(rp.z + 0.8, 1.6) - 0.8;",
    "      float pillar = length(rp.xz) - 0.18 + 0.024 * cos(atan(rp.z, rp.x) * 8.0);",
    "      float archRib = abs(length(vec2(pos.x, pos.y + 0.34)) - 1.24) - 0.055 + 0.035 * abs(rp.z);",
    "      float vault = 1.04 - abs(pos.y) - 0.18 * abs(pos.x);",
    "      d = min(min(pillar, archRib), vault);",
    "    } else if(archMode < 2.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos;",
    "      float oct = max(abs(rp.x), abs(rp.y)) * 0.82 + length(rp.xy) * 0.35;",
    "      float tunnel = 1.34 - oct;",
    "      float ribs = abs(mod(rp.z + 0.45, 0.9) - 0.45) - 0.045;",
    "      float trench = max(tunnel - 0.14, -ribs);",
    "      float laserB = length(vec2(abs(rp.x) - 0.94, abs(rp.y) - 0.54)) - 0.024;",
    "      glowAcc += 0.012 / (0.016 + max(0.0, laserB * laserB));",
    "      d = min(trench, laserB);",
    "    } else if(archMode < 3.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos; rp.xy = rot2(rp.xy, 0.16 * floor(rp.z * 0.8));",
    "      rp.x = abs(rp.x) - 1.20; rp.z = mod(rp.z + 0.65, 1.3) - 0.65;",
    "      float hexP = max(abs(rp.x) * 0.866 + abs(rp.z) * 0.5, abs(rp.z)) - 0.25 + 0.07 * rp.y;",
    "      float cavern = 0.96 - abs(pos.y) + 0.05 * sin(pos.x * 5.0 + pos.z * 3.0);",
    "      d = min(hexP, cavern);",
    "    } else if(archMode < 4.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos; rp.z = mod(rp.z + 0.9, 1.8) - 0.9;",
    "      float r = length(rp.xy);",
    "      float ang = atan(rp.y, rp.x) + t * 0.25 * (pos.z > 0.0 ? 1.0 : -1.0);",
    "      float gearR = max(abs(r - 1.20) - 0.13 + 0.042 * smoothstep(-0.2, 0.2, cos(ang * 24.0)), abs(rp.z) - 0.08);",
    "      float wall = 1.52 - r;",
    "      glowAcc += 0.008 / (0.02 + abs(r - 1.16) + abs(rp.z));",
    "      d = min(gearR, wall);",
    "    } else {",
    "      vec3 rp = pos;",
    "      float r = length(rp.xy + vec2(0.0, 1.62));",
    "      float ringD = abs(r - 2.32) - 0.08 + 0.02 * sin(rp.x * 12.0) * sin(rp.z * 12.0);",
    "      float struts = max(abs(abs(rp.x) - 1.32) - 0.08, abs(mod(rp.z + 0.6, 1.2) - 0.6) - 0.08);",
    "      glowAcc += 0.010 / (0.02 + abs(pos.y + 0.42) + abs(abs(pos.x) - 1.12));",
    "      d = min(ringD, struts);",
    "    }",
    "    if(d < 0.012){ hit = 1.0; hitPos = pos; break; }",
    "    edgeAcc += 0.016 / (0.04 + d * d * 6.0);",
    "    totalD += d * 0.72;",
    "    if(totalD > 8.5) break;",
    "  }",
    "  float fog = exp(-totalD * 0.28);",
    "  vec3 archCol = mix(wCol * 0.45, F0 * 0.28 + subCol * 0.35, (1.0 - fog) * 0.55);",
    "  if(hit > 0.5){",
    "    float stripe = 0.5 + 0.5 * cos(hitPos.z * 14.0) * cos(hitPos.x * 10.0);",
    "    float spec = pow(max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(hitPos.y) * 0.75), 4.0) * (0.4 + 0.6 * stripe);",
    "    archCol = mix(archCol, F0 * (0.28 + 0.52 * spec) + subCol * 0.35, fog * 0.68);",
    "  }",
    "  archCol += F0 * edgeAcc * 0.14 + (F0 * 0.7 + vec3(0.35, 0.65, 1.0) * 0.3) * glowAcc * 0.24;",
    "  return mix(wCol, archCol + wCol * 0.68, 0.46);",
    "}",
    "// 12-Slice 3D Raymarched Parallax Extrusion + 12-Tap Volumetric God-Rays + Anamorphic Lens Flare + Shockwave",
    "vec3 integrateWorldTypography(vec3 wColOrig, vec2 p, vec2 sc, vec2 hs, vec3 keyL, vec3 F0, vec3 baseAlb, vec3 subCol, float lRough, float reveal, float layoutMode){",
    "  float tImp = 1.65;",
    "  vec3 wCol = world3DPass(p, T, wColOrig, F0, subCol, mod(layoutMode + floor(F0.r * 7.0), 6.0));",
    "  // 1. 3D Perspective Camera Tilt, Dolly Zoom & Refractive Impact Shockwave",
    "  float impKick = exp(-max(0.0, T - tImp) * 4.2) * step(tImp, T);",
    "  float shockT = max(0.0, T - tImp);",
    "  float shockRing = exp(-pow((length(p - sc) - shockT * 1.65) * 9.5, 2.0)) * exp(-shockT * 1.9) * step(0.001, shockT);",
    "  vec2 qLocal = p - sc + normalize(p - sc + vec2(1e-5)) * shockRing * 0.026;",
    "  vec2 camTilt = vec2(0.22 * sin(T * 0.62), 0.14 * cos(T * 0.48)) * (1.0 - 0.62 * smoothstep(tImp, tImp + 1.35, T));",
    "  float perspZ = 1.0 + dot(qLocal, camTilt) * 0.44;",
    "  float zoom3D = mix(1.16, 1.0, smoothstep(0.45, tImp + 0.35, T)) - 0.035 * impKick * cos((T - tImp) * 34.0);",
    "  vec2 q3D = (qLocal / max(0.55, perspZ)) * zoom3D;",
    "  vec2 uv = q3D / (hs * 2.0) + 0.5;",
    "  // Panavision Anamorphic Horizontal Lens Flare & Shockwave Glow across full viewport",
    "  float flareEnv = smoothstep(tImp - 0.30, tImp + 0.15, T) * (0.52 + 0.68 * exp(-max(0.0, T - tImp) * 1.6));",
    "  float streak1 = exp(-abs(p.y - sc.y - 0.015) * 44.0) * exp(-abs(p.x) * 1.10);",
    "  float streak2 = exp(-abs(p.y - sc.y + 0.075) * 68.0) * exp(-abs(p.x - 0.06) * 1.35);",
    "  vec3 anamorphic = (vec3(0.36, 0.74, 1.0) * 0.48 + F0 * 0.68) * (streak1 * 0.68 + streak2 * 0.42) * flareEnv;",
    "  float ghost = exp(-abs(length((p - sc) * vec2(0.72, 1.38) + vec2(0.16, -0.05)) - 0.26) * 28.0) * 0.22 * flareEnv;",
    "  wCol += anamorphic + F0 * ghost + (F0 * 0.8 + vec3(0.4, 0.7, 1.0) * 0.4) * shockRing * 0.75;",
    "  if(uv.x < -0.18 || uv.x > 1.18 || uv.y < -0.18 || uv.y > 1.18) return wCol;",
    "  vec2 flipUV = clamp(uv, 0.0, 1.0);",
    "  float inBounds = step(0.0, uv.x) * step(uv.x, 1.0) * step(0.0, uv.y) * step(uv.y, 1.0);",
    "  vec2 texel = vec2(1.0 / 1024.0, 1.0 / 768.0);",
    "  float hC = texture2D(TX, flipUV).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hR = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV + vec2(texel.x * 2.0, 0.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hL = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV - vec2(texel.x * 2.0, 0.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hU = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV + vec2(0.0, texel.y * 2.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hD = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV - vec2(0.0, texel.y * 2.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float core = texture2D(TX, flipUV).g * inBounds;",
    "  float waveMask = reveal;",
    "  float edgeGlow = 0.0;",
    "  if(layoutMode < 0.5){",
    "    float rU = length((uv - 0.5) * vec2(1.33, 1.0));",
    "    float front = reveal * 0.96;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.08, front - 0.04, rU) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = exp(-pow((rU - front) * 18.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else if(layoutMode < 1.5){",
    "    float front = mix(-0.1, 1.15, reveal);",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.08, front - 0.04, uv.x) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = exp(-pow((uv.x - front) * 20.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else if(layoutMode < 2.5){",
    "    float front = mix(-0.25, 1.25, reveal);",
    "    float coord = uv.x * 0.82 + (1.0 - uv.y) * 0.28;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.12, front - 0.06, coord) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = 1.25 * exp(-pow((coord - front) * 16.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else if(layoutMode < 4.5){",
    "    float rU = abs(uv.x - 0.5) * 1.45;",
    "    float front = reveal * 0.95;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.10, front - 0.06, rU) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = exp(-pow((rU - front) * 16.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else {",
    "    float rU = length((uv - 0.5) * vec2(1.25, 1.0));",
    "    float front = reveal * 0.95;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.10, front - 0.06, rU) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = 1.2 * exp(-pow((rU - front) * 16.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  }",
    "  float letterMask = smoothstep(0.14, 0.64, max(core, hC * 0.62)) * waveMask * inBounds;",
    "  // 2. 12-Slice 3D Raymarched Parallax Extrusion along Perspective View/Light Axis",
    "  vec2 extrudeDir = normalize((uv - 0.5) - keyL.xy * 0.28 + vec2(1e-4)) * (0.026 + 0.014 * (1.0 - reveal));",
    "  float sideMask = 0.0;",
    "  float sideDepth = 1.0;",
    "  for(int i = 1; i <= 12; i++){",
    "    float fi = float(i) / 12.0;",
    "    vec2 sUV = uv - extrudeDir * fi;",
    "    float sIn = step(0.0, sUV.x) * step(sUV.x, 1.0) * step(0.0, sUV.y) * step(sUV.y, 1.0);",
    "    vec4 sTex = texture2D(TX, clamp(sUV, 0.0, 1.0)) * sIn;",
    "    float sHit = smoothstep(0.18, 0.58, max(sTex.g, sTex.r * 0.58)) * waveMask;",
    "    if(sHit > 0.25 && sideMask < 0.5){ sideMask = sHit; sideDepth = fi; }",
    "  }",
    "  // 3. 12-Tap Volumetric God-Ray Occlusion Shafts bursting through the 3D Extruded Letters",
    "  vec2 lightUV = vec2(0.5 + keyL.x * 0.18, 0.5 + keyL.y * 0.16);",
    "  vec2 rayStep = (uv - lightUV) / 12.0;",
    "  vec2 rUV = uv;",
    "  float godRay = 0.0, rW = 1.0;",
    "  for(int i = 0; i < 12; i++){",
    "    rUV -= rayStep * 0.88;",
    "    float rIn = step(0.0, rUV.x) * step(rUV.x, 1.0) * step(0.0, rUV.y) * step(rUV.y, 1.0);",
    "    vec4 rT = texture2D(TX, clamp(rUV, 0.0, 1.0)) * rIn;",
    "    float rEdge = max(rT.g, rT.r * 0.7) * waveMask;",
    "    godRay += (rEdge * (1.0 - letterMask * 0.65) + 0.14 * exp(-length(rUV - lightUV) * 4.5)) * rW;",
    "    rW *= 0.86;",
    "  }",
    "  godRay = (godRay / 6.2) * smoothstep(0.25, 1.55, T) * (1.0 + 0.75 * impKick);",
    "  // 4. Deep 3D Contact Shadow & Planar Horizon Reflection",
    "  float shadow = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV - keyL.xy * 0.012, 0.0, 1.0)).r * waveMask * inBounds;",
    "  vec3 worldBed = wCol * (1.0 - 0.88 * clamp(hC * 1.75, 0.0, 1.0) * waveMask) * (1.0 - 0.74 * max(shadow, sideMask * 0.75) * (1.0 - core));",
    "  worldBed += (F0 * 0.75 + vec3(0.42, 0.72, 1.0) * 0.25) * godRay * 0.48;",
    "  if(abs(layoutMode - 5.0) < 0.4 && uv.y < 0.44 && inBounds > 0.5){",
    "    float dy = 0.44 - uv.y;",
    "    float ripX = sin(dy * 95.0 - T * 4.5) * 0.008 * (0.4 + dy * 2.0);",
    "    vec2 refUV = vec2(clamp(uv.x + ripX, 0.0, 1.0), clamp(0.44 + dy * 1.05, 0.0, 1.0));",
    "    float rCore = texture2D(TX, refUV).g * waveMask;",
    "    worldBed += F0 * rCore * exp(-dy * 4.8) * 0.48;",
    "  }",
    "  // 5. Shade the 3D Extruded Metallic Side-Walls with Brushed Anisotropy + Rim Specular",
    "  vec3 V = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);",
    "  vec3 L = normalize(keyL + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.45));",
    "  vec3 fillL = normalize(vec3(-L.x * 0.85, -L.y * 0.55 + 0.32, 0.72));",
    "  float onlySide = clamp(sideMask * (1.0 - letterMask * 0.96), 0.0, 1.0);",
    "  if(onlySide > 0.001){",
    "    vec2 sTang = normalize(extrudeDir + vec2(1e-5));",
    "    vec3 sideN = normalize(vec3(sTang.x * 0.86, sTang.y * 0.86, 0.50));",
    "    float brushed = 0.72 + 0.28 * sin(sideDepth * 42.0 + uv.x * 60.0);",
    "    float sideAtten = (1.0 - 0.55 * sideDepth) * brushed;",
    "    vec3 sideCol = ggx(sideN, V, L, lRough + 0.06, F0 * 0.88, baseAlb * 0.7) * 1.65 * sideAtten;",
    "    sideCol += F0 * pow(1.0 - sideDepth, 2.2) * 0.38;",
    "    worldBed = mix(worldBed, sideCol, onlySide);",
    "  }",
    "  // 6. Shade the Diamond-Cut Beveled Front Face",
    "  vec3 N = normalize(vec3((hL - hR) * 5.2, (hD - hU) * 5.2, 0.26));",
    "  vec3 metalCol = ggx(N, V, L, lRough, F0, baseAlb) + ggx(N, V, fillL, lRough + 0.06, F0 * 0.92, baseAlb) * 0.52;",
    "  float sweepPos = mix(-0.85, 0.85, clamp((T - 1.50) / 1.95, 0.0, 1.0));",
    "  float sweep = exp(-pow((uv.x - 0.5 - sweepPos * 0.65 + (uv.y - 0.5)*0.22) * 7.5, 2.0)) * smoothstep(1.30, 1.90, T);",
    "  metalCol += F0 * (0.30 + 1.45 * sweep + 1.55 * edgeGlow);",
    "  return mix(worldBed, metalCol, clamp(letterMask, 0.0, 1.0));",
    "}",
    "void sceneWorld(vec2 p, vec3 ro, vec3 rd, float t, float A, vec4 U0, vec4 U1, out vec3 wCol, out float reveal, out vec3 keyL){",
    "float moonSweep = mix(-0.55, 0.22, smoothstep(0.0, 3.8, t));",
    "keyL = normalize(vec3(moonSweep, 0.68, 0.62));",
    "// 3D Raymarched gallery colonnade & coffered skylight",
    "vec3 col = vec3(0.012, 0.016, 0.028);",
    "float zFloor = (-0.52 - ro.y) / min(rd.y, -0.08);",
    "if(rd.y < -0.02 && zFloor > 0.0 && zFloor < 14.0){",
    "vec3 fp = ro + rd * zFloor;",
    "vec2 tile = fract(fp.xz * 0.85) - 0.5;",
    "float grout = smoothstep(0.02, 0.005, 0.5 - max(abs(tile.x), abs(tile.y)));",
    "float vein = pow(fbm5(fp.xz * 2.4 + fbm3(fp.xz * 5.0)), 3.0);",
    "vec3 marble = mix(vec3(0.015, 0.018, 0.025), vec3(0.32, 0.36, 0.45), vein * 0.65) + vec3(0.18, 0.15, 0.08)*grout;",
    "float refl = exp(-length(fp.x - moonSweep*1.2)*1.8) * exp(-zFloor*0.22);",
    "col = mix(col, marble + vec3(0.16, 0.22, 0.38)*refl, exp(-zFloor*0.18));",
    "}",
    "// Fluted marble columns in 3D perspective on left and right",
    "for(int i=0; i<3; i++){",
    "float fi = float(i);",
    "float cz = 1.6 + fi * 1.15 - mod(t*0.25, 1.15);",
    "float cx = (0.48 + 0.18*A) / max(cz * 0.55, 0.35);",
    "float dCol = abs(abs(p.x) - cx) - 0.065 / max(cz * 0.45, 0.35);",
    "if(dCol < 0.0){",
    "float u = (abs(p.x) - cx) / (0.065 / max(cz * 0.45, 0.35));",
    "float flute = 0.5 + 0.5 * cos(u * 22.0);",
    "float cLit = max(0.0, -sign(p.x)*moonSweep + 0.45) * (0.35 + 0.65*flute) * exp(-cz*0.28);",
    "col = mix(col, vec3(0.08, 0.10, 0.16) + vec3(0.28, 0.34, 0.52)*cLit, smoothstep(0.0, -0.006, dCol));",
    "}",
    "}",
    "// Volumetric moonlight shaft from overhead skylight + vitrine glass reflection",
    "float beam = exp(-pow((p.x - p.y * moonSweep * 0.85) * 2.4, 2.0)) * smoothstep(0.05, 1.4, t);",
    "float dust = fbm3(p * 4.5 + vec2(-t*0.12, t*0.08));",
    "col += vec3(0.18, 0.26, 0.46) * beam * (0.25 + 0.95 * dust * dust);",
    "",
    "// 3D Gold Medallion emerging inside the velvet vitrine",
    "float coinRise = smoothstep(0.65, 2.1, t);",
    "",
    "// Sliding museum vitrine glass edge catching moonlight",
    "float glassSlide = mix(0.0, 0.75 * A, smoothstep(0.85, 2.25, t));",
    "float gEdge = smoothstep(0.008, 0.0, abs(abs(p.x) - glassSlide));",
    "col += vec3(0.55, 0.72, 0.95) * gEdge * 0.55;",
    "// Volumetric Sanctuary Zenith Light Cone & Depth-of-Field Atmospheric Bokeh",
    "wCol = col;",
    "reveal = smoothstep(1.35, 2.55, t);",
    "}",
    "void main(){",
    "  vec2 p = (gl_FragCoord.xy - 0.5 * R) / R.y;",
    "  float A = R.x / R.y, t = T;",
    "  float impact = exp(-max(0.0, t - 1.750) * 14.0) * step(1.750, t);",
    "  vec2 shake = vec2(sin(t * 92.0), cos(t * 118.0)) * impact * 0.0065;",
    "  p += shake;",
    "  vec2 hs = U0.xy, sc = vec2(0.0, U0.w);",
    "  float dolly = mix(1.22, 1.0, smoothstep(0.0, 3.6, t));",
    "  vec3 ro = vec3(sin(t * 0.35) * 0.035, cos(t * 0.28) * 0.025, -2.15 * dolly);",
    "  vec3 rd = normalize(vec3(p * dolly, 1.35));",
    "  vec3 wCol = vec3(0.0); float reveal = 0.0; vec3 keyL = normalize(vec3(0.42, 0.58, 0.70));",
    "  sceneWorld(p, ro, rd, t, A, U0, U1, wCol, reveal, keyL);",
    "  vec3 col = integrateWorldTypography(wCol, p, sc, hs, keyL, vec3(0.940,0.820,0.520), vec3(0.040,0.030,0.010), vec3(0.040,0.045,0.060), 0.160, reveal, 2.0);",
    "  float vig = 1.0 - 0.36 * smoothstep(0.44, 1.08, length(p * vec2(1.0 / max(A, 0.65) * 1.12, 1.0)));",
    "  col = aces(col * 1.08) * vig;",
    "  col += vec3((h21(gl_FragCoord.xy + floor(t * 24.0) * 7.3) - 0.5) * 0.012);",
    "  gl_FragColor = vec4(clamp(col, 0.0, 1.0), 1.0);",
    "}"
  ].join("\n");

    "// Studio & Sanctuary IBL + Multi-Lobe Microfacet GGX BRDF (Dark base + 3-Dome Env Reflection + Rim Kicker)",
    "vec3 ggx(vec3 N, vec3 V, vec3 L, float rough, vec3 F0, vec3 diffAlb){",
    "  N = normalize(N); V = normalize(V); L = normalize(L);",
    "  vec3 H = normalize(V + L);",
    "  float NdotL = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);",
    "  float NdotV = max(dot(N, V), 0.001);",
    "  float NdotH = max(dot(N, H), 0.0);",
    "  float VdotH = max(dot(V, H), 0.0);",
    "  float a = max(rough * rough, 0.004); float a2 = a * a;",
    "  float d = (NdotH * a2 - NdotH) * NdotH + 1.0;",
    "  float D = a2 / (3.14159265 * d * d + 1e-5);",
    "  vec3 F = F0 + (1.0 - F0) * pow(clamp(1.0 - VdotH, 0.0, 1.0), 5.0);",
    "  float k = (rough + 1.0) * (rough + 1.0) * 0.125;",
    "  float G = (NdotV / (NdotV * (1.0 - k) + k)) * (NdotL / (NdotL * (1.0 - k) + k));",
    "  vec3 spec = (D * F * G) / (4.0 * NdotV * NdotL + 0.001) * NdotL;",
    "  vec3 diff = diffAlb * (1.0 - F) * (0.35 + 0.65 * NdotL);",
    "  // 3D Studio PMREM-Style Environment Reflection (Overhead Softbox + Key Strip + Horizon Rim)",
    "  vec3 R = reflect(-V, N);",
    "  float softbox = smoothstep(-0.2, 0.85, R.y) * (0.55 + 0.45 * cos(R.x * 3.5));",
    "  float keyStrip = exp(-length(R.xy - L.xy * 0.65) * 2.4);",
    "  float rimKick = pow(1.0 - NdotV, 2.6);",
    "  vec3 envLight = F0 * (0.28 * softbox + 0.52 * keyStrip + 0.25 * rimKick) * (1.0 - rough * 0.52);",
    "  return diff + spec * 1.15 + envLight;",
    "}",
    "// --- V6 FUTURISTIC HOLLYWOOD IMAX / THX 3D RAYMARCHED ARCHITECTURE & 12-SLICE EXTRUSION ENGINE ---",
    "vec3 world3DPass(vec2 p, float t, vec3 wCol, vec3 F0, vec3 subCol, float archMode){",
    "  float tImp = 1.65;",
    "  float dolly = t * 1.35 + smoothstep(tImp - 0.15, tImp + 0.35, t) * 0.65;",
    "  float roll = 0.035 * sin(t * 0.55) + 0.022 * exp(-max(0.0, t - tImp) * 5.0) * sin((t - tImp) * 32.0);",
    "  vec2 q = rot2(p, roll);",
    "  vec3 ro = vec3(0.10 * sin(t * 0.42), 0.05 * cos(t * 0.36), dolly);",
    "  vec3 rd = normalize(vec3(q * 1.18, 1.42));",
    "  float totalD = 0.0, glowAcc = 0.0, edgeAcc = 0.0, hit = 0.0;",
    "  vec3 hitPos = ro;",
    "  for(int i = 0; i < 16; i++){",
    "    vec3 pos = ro + rd * totalD;",
    "    float d = 10.0;",
    "    if(archMode < 0.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos; rp.x = abs(rp.x) - 1.32; rp.z = mod(rp.z + 0.7, 1.4) - 0.7;",
    "      float cyl = length(rp.xz) - 0.23 + 0.018 * cos(atan(rp.z, rp.x) * 16.0);",
    "      float cap = max(abs(pos.y) - 0.76, length(rp.xz) - 0.33);",
    "      float flCeil = 0.88 - abs(pos.y) + 0.025 * cos(pos.x * 8.0) * cos(pos.z * 8.0);",
    "      d = min(min(cyl, cap), flCeil);",
    "    } else if(archMode < 1.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos; rp.x = abs(rp.x) - 1.26; rp.z = mod(rp.z + 0.8, 1.6) - 0.8;",
    "      float pillar = length(rp.xz) - 0.18 + 0.024 * cos(atan(rp.z, rp.x) * 8.0);",
    "      float archRib = abs(length(vec2(pos.x, pos.y + 0.34)) - 1.24) - 0.055 + 0.035 * abs(rp.z);",
    "      float vault = 1.04 - abs(pos.y) - 0.18 * abs(pos.x);",
    "      d = min(min(pillar, archRib), vault);",
    "    } else if(archMode < 2.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos;",
    "      float oct = max(abs(rp.x), abs(rp.y)) * 0.82 + length(rp.xy) * 0.35;",
    "      float tunnel = 1.34 - oct;",
    "      float ribs = abs(mod(rp.z + 0.45, 0.9) - 0.45) - 0.045;",
    "      float trench = max(tunnel - 0.14, -ribs);",
    "      float laserB = length(vec2(abs(rp.x) - 0.94, abs(rp.y) - 0.54)) - 0.024;",
    "      glowAcc += 0.012 / (0.016 + max(0.0, laserB * laserB));",
    "      d = min(trench, laserB);",
    "    } else if(archMode < 3.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos; rp.xy = rot2(rp.xy, 0.16 * floor(rp.z * 0.8));",
    "      rp.x = abs(rp.x) - 1.20; rp.z = mod(rp.z + 0.65, 1.3) - 0.65;",
    "      float hexP = max(abs(rp.x) * 0.866 + abs(rp.z) * 0.5, abs(rp.z)) - 0.25 + 0.07 * rp.y;",
    "      float cavern = 0.96 - abs(pos.y) + 0.05 * sin(pos.x * 5.0 + pos.z * 3.0);",
    "      d = min(hexP, cavern);",
    "    } else if(archMode < 4.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos; rp.z = mod(rp.z + 0.9, 1.8) - 0.9;",
    "      float r = length(rp.xy);",
    "      float ang = atan(rp.y, rp.x) + t * 0.25 * (pos.z > 0.0 ? 1.0 : -1.0);",
    "      float gearR = max(abs(r - 1.20) - 0.13 + 0.042 * smoothstep(-0.2, 0.2, cos(ang * 24.0)), abs(rp.z) - 0.08);",
    "      float wall = 1.52 - r;",
    "      glowAcc += 0.008 / (0.02 + abs(r - 1.16) + abs(rp.z));",
    "      d = min(gearR, wall);",
    "    } else {",
    "      vec3 rp = pos;",
    "      float r = length(rp.xy + vec2(0.0, 1.62));",
    "      float ringD = abs(r - 2.32) - 0.08 + 0.02 * sin(rp.x * 12.0) * sin(rp.z * 12.0);",
    "      float struts = max(abs(abs(rp.x) - 1.32) - 0.08, abs(mod(rp.z + 0.6, 1.2) - 0.6) - 0.08);",
    "      glowAcc += 0.010 / (0.02 + abs(pos.y + 0.42) + abs(abs(pos.x) - 1.12));",
    "      d = min(ringD, struts);",
    "    }",
    "    if(d < 0.012){ hit = 1.0; hitPos = pos; break; }",
    "    edgeAcc += 0.016 / (0.04 + d * d * 6.0);",
    "    totalD += d * 0.72;",
    "    if(totalD > 8.5) break;",
    "  }",
    "  float fog = exp(-totalD * 0.28);",
    "  vec3 archCol = mix(wCol * 0.45, F0 * 0.28 + subCol * 0.35, (1.0 - fog) * 0.55);",
    "  if(hit > 0.5){",
    "    float stripe = 0.5 + 0.5 * cos(hitPos.z * 14.0) * cos(hitPos.x * 10.0);",
    "    float spec = pow(max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(hitPos.y) * 0.75), 4.0) * (0.4 + 0.6 * stripe);",
    "    archCol = mix(archCol, F0 * (0.28 + 0.52 * spec) + subCol * 0.35, fog * 0.68);",
    "  }",
    "  archCol += F0 * edgeAcc * 0.14 + (F0 * 0.7 + vec3(0.35, 0.65, 1.0) * 0.3) * glowAcc * 0.24;",
    "  return mix(wCol, archCol + wCol * 0.68, 0.46);",
    "}",
    "// 12-Slice 3D Raymarched Parallax Extrusion + 12-Tap Volumetric God-Rays + Anamorphic Lens Flare + Shockwave",
    "vec3 integrateWorldTypography(vec3 wColOrig, vec2 p, vec2 sc, vec2 hs, vec3 keyL, vec3 F0, vec3 baseAlb, vec3 subCol, float lRough, float reveal, float layoutMode){",
    "  float tImp = 1.65;",
    "  vec3 wCol = world3DPass(p, T, wColOrig, F0, subCol, mod(layoutMode + floor(F0.r * 7.0), 6.0));",
    "  // 1. 3D Perspective Camera Tilt, Dolly Zoom & Refractive Impact Shockwave",
    "  float impKick = exp(-max(0.0, T - tImp) * 4.2) * step(tImp, T);",
    "  float shockT = max(0.0, T - tImp);",
    "  float shockRing = exp(-pow((length(p - sc) - shockT * 1.65) * 9.5, 2.0)) * exp(-shockT * 1.9) * step(0.001, shockT);",
    "  vec2 qLocal = p - sc + normalize(p - sc + vec2(1e-5)) * shockRing * 0.026;",
    "  vec2 camTilt = vec2(0.22 * sin(T * 0.62), 0.14 * cos(T * 0.48)) * (1.0 - 0.62 * smoothstep(tImp, tImp + 1.35, T));",
    "  float perspZ = 1.0 + dot(qLocal, camTilt) * 0.44;",
    "  float zoom3D = mix(1.16, 1.0, smoothstep(0.45, tImp + 0.35, T)) - 0.035 * impKick * cos((T - tImp) * 34.0);",
    "  vec2 q3D = (qLocal / max(0.55, perspZ)) * zoom3D;",
    "  vec2 uv = q3D / (hs * 2.0) + 0.5;",
    "  // Panavision Anamorphic Horizontal Lens Flare & Shockwave Glow across full viewport",
    "  float flareEnv = smoothstep(tImp - 0.30, tImp + 0.15, T) * (0.52 + 0.68 * exp(-max(0.0, T - tImp) * 1.6));",
    "  float streak1 = exp(-abs(p.y - sc.y - 0.015) * 44.0) * exp(-abs(p.x) * 1.10);",
    "  float streak2 = exp(-abs(p.y - sc.y + 0.075) * 68.0) * exp(-abs(p.x - 0.06) * 1.35);",
    "  vec3 anamorphic = (vec3(0.36, 0.74, 1.0) * 0.48 + F0 * 0.68) * (streak1 * 0.68 + streak2 * 0.42) * flareEnv;",
    "  float ghost = exp(-abs(length((p - sc) * vec2(0.72, 1.38) + vec2(0.16, -0.05)) - 0.26) * 28.0) * 0.22 * flareEnv;",
    "  wCol += anamorphic + F0 * ghost + (F0 * 0.8 + vec3(0.4, 0.7, 1.0) * 0.4) * shockRing * 0.75;",
    "  if(uv.x < -0.18 || uv.x > 1.18 || uv.y < -0.18 || uv.y > 1.18) return wCol;",
    "  vec2 flipUV = clamp(uv, 0.0, 1.0);",
    "  float inBounds = step(0.0, uv.x) * step(uv.x, 1.0) * step(0.0, uv.y) * step(uv.y, 1.0);",
    "  vec2 texel = vec2(1.0 / 1024.0, 1.0 / 768.0);",
    "  float hC = texture2D(TX, flipUV).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hR = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV + vec2(texel.x * 2.0, 0.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hL = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV - vec2(texel.x * 2.0, 0.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hU = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV + vec2(0.0, texel.y * 2.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hD = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV - vec2(0.0, texel.y * 2.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float core = texture2D(TX, flipUV).g * inBounds;",
    "  float waveMask = reveal;",
    "  float edgeGlow = 0.0;",
    "  if(layoutMode < 0.5){",
    "    float rU = length((uv - 0.5) * vec2(1.33, 1.0));",
    "    float front = reveal * 0.96;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.08, front - 0.04, rU) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = exp(-pow((rU - front) * 18.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else if(layoutMode < 1.5){",
    "    float front = mix(-0.1, 1.15, reveal);",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.08, front - 0.04, uv.x) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = exp(-pow((uv.x - front) * 20.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else if(layoutMode < 2.5){",
    "    float front = mix(-0.25, 1.25, reveal);",
    "    float coord = uv.x * 0.82 + (1.0 - uv.y) * 0.28;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.12, front - 0.06, coord) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = 1.25 * exp(-pow((coord - front) * 16.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else if(layoutMode < 4.5){",
    "    float rU = abs(uv.x - 0.5) * 1.45;",
    "    float front = reveal * 0.95;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.10, front - 0.06, rU) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = exp(-pow((rU - front) * 16.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else {",
    "    float rU = length((uv - 0.5) * vec2(1.25, 1.0));",
    "    float front = reveal * 0.95;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.10, front - 0.06, rU) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = 1.2 * exp(-pow((rU - front) * 16.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  }",
    "  float letterMask = smoothstep(0.14, 0.64, max(core, hC * 0.62)) * waveMask * inBounds;",
    "  // 2. 12-Slice 3D Raymarched Parallax Extrusion along Perspective View/Light Axis",
    "  vec2 extrudeDir = normalize((uv - 0.5) - keyL.xy * 0.28 + vec2(1e-4)) * (0.026 + 0.014 * (1.0 - reveal));",
    "  float sideMask = 0.0;",
    "  float sideDepth = 1.0;",
    "  for(int i = 1; i <= 12; i++){",
    "    float fi = float(i) / 12.0;",
    "    vec2 sUV = uv - extrudeDir * fi;",
    "    float sIn = step(0.0, sUV.x) * step(sUV.x, 1.0) * step(0.0, sUV.y) * step(sUV.y, 1.0);",
    "    vec4 sTex = texture2D(TX, clamp(sUV, 0.0, 1.0)) * sIn;",
    "    float sHit = smoothstep(0.18, 0.58, max(sTex.g, sTex.r * 0.58)) * waveMask;",
    "    if(sHit > 0.25 && sideMask < 0.5){ sideMask = sHit; sideDepth = fi; }",
    "  }",
    "  // 3. 12-Tap Volumetric God-Ray Occlusion Shafts bursting through the 3D Extruded Letters",
    "  vec2 lightUV = vec2(0.5 + keyL.x * 0.18, 0.5 + keyL.y * 0.16);",
    "  vec2 rayStep = (uv - lightUV) / 12.0;",
    "  vec2 rUV = uv;",
    "  float godRay = 0.0, rW = 1.0;",
    "  for(int i = 0; i < 12; i++){",
    "    rUV -= rayStep * 0.88;",
    "    float rIn = step(0.0, rUV.x) * step(rUV.x, 1.0) * step(0.0, rUV.y) * step(rUV.y, 1.0);",
    "    vec4 rT = texture2D(TX, clamp(rUV, 0.0, 1.0)) * rIn;",
    "    float rEdge = max(rT.g, rT.r * 0.7) * waveMask;",
    "    godRay += (rEdge * (1.0 - letterMask * 0.65) + 0.14 * exp(-length(rUV - lightUV) * 4.5)) * rW;",
    "    rW *= 0.86;",
    "  }",
    "  godRay = (godRay / 6.2) * smoothstep(0.25, 1.55, T) * (1.0 + 0.75 * impKick);",
    "  // 4. Deep 3D Contact Shadow & Planar Horizon Reflection",
    "  float shadow = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV - keyL.xy * 0.012, 0.0, 1.0)).r * waveMask * inBounds;",
    "  vec3 worldBed = wCol * (1.0 - 0.88 * clamp(hC * 1.75, 0.0, 1.0) * waveMask) * (1.0 - 0.74 * max(shadow, sideMask * 0.75) * (1.0 - core));",
    "  worldBed += (F0 * 0.75 + vec3(0.42, 0.72, 1.0) * 0.25) * godRay * 0.48;",
    "  if(abs(layoutMode - 5.0) < 0.4 && uv.y < 0.44 && inBounds > 0.5){",
    "    float dy = 0.44 - uv.y;",
    "    float ripX = sin(dy * 95.0 - T * 4.5) * 0.008 * (0.4 + dy * 2.0);",
    "    vec2 refUV = vec2(clamp(uv.x + ripX, 0.0, 1.0), clamp(0.44 + dy * 1.05, 0.0, 1.0));",
    "    float rCore = texture2D(TX, refUV).g * waveMask;",
    "    worldBed += F0 * rCore * exp(-dy * 4.8) * 0.48;",
    "  }",
    "  // 5. Shade the 3D Extruded Metallic Side-Walls with Brushed Anisotropy + Rim Specular",
    "  vec3 V = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);",
    "  vec3 L = normalize(keyL + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.45));",
    "  vec3 fillL = normalize(vec3(-L.x * 0.85, -L.y * 0.55 + 0.32, 0.72));",
    "  float onlySide = clamp(sideMask * (1.0 - letterMask * 0.96), 0.0, 1.0);",
    "  if(onlySide > 0.001){",
    "    vec2 sTang = normalize(extrudeDir + vec2(1e-5));",
    "    vec3 sideN = normalize(vec3(sTang.x * 0.86, sTang.y * 0.86, 0.50));",
    "    float brushed = 0.72 + 0.28 * sin(sideDepth * 42.0 + uv.x * 60.0);",
    "    float sideAtten = (1.0 - 0.55 * sideDepth) * brushed;",
    "    vec3 sideCol = ggx(sideN, V, L, lRough + 0.06, F0 * 0.88, baseAlb * 0.7) * 1.65 * sideAtten;",
    "    sideCol += F0 * pow(1.0 - sideDepth, 2.2) * 0.38;",
    "    worldBed = mix(worldBed, sideCol, onlySide);",
    "  }",
    "  // 6. Shade the Diamond-Cut Beveled Front Face",
    "  vec3 N = normalize(vec3((hL - hR) * 5.2, (hD - hU) * 5.2, 0.26));",
    "  vec3 metalCol = ggx(N, V, L, lRough, F0, baseAlb) + ggx(N, V, fillL, lRough + 0.06, F0 * 0.92, baseAlb) * 0.52;",
    "  float sweepPos = mix(-0.85, 0.85, clamp((T - 1.50) / 1.95, 0.0, 1.0));",
    "  float sweep = exp(-pow((uv.x - 0.5 - sweepPos * 0.65 + (uv.y - 0.5)*0.22) * 7.5, 2.0)) * smoothstep(1.30, 1.90, T);",
    "  metalCol += F0 * (0.30 + 1.45 * sweep + 1.55 * edgeGlow);",
    "  return mix(worldBed, metalCol, clamp(letterMask, 0.0, 1.0));",
    "}",
    "void sceneWorld(vec2 p, vec3 ro, vec3 rd, float t, float A, vec4 U0, vec4 U1, out vec3 wCol, out float reveal, out vec3 keyL){",
    "  float flicker = 0.86 + 0.14 * sin(t * 17.0 + sin(t * 9.0));",
    "  keyL = normalize(vec3(sin(t*1.3)*0.32, -0.42, 0.84));",
    "  // Starry Sierra Madre indigo night sky above jagged mountain & pine silhouettes",
    "  vec3 sky = mix(vec3(0.015, 0.024, 0.055), vec3(0.04, 0.055, 0.11), clamp(p.y + 0.3, 0.0, 1.0));",
    "  vec2 stCell = floor(p * 32.0);",
    "  vec2 stUv = fract(p * 32.0) - 0.5;",
    "  float star = smoothstep(0.08, 0.01, length(stUv)) * step(0.91, h21(stCell)) * step(0.0, p.y);",
    "  sky += vec3(0.85, 0.92, 1.0) * star * 0.55;",
    "  // Layered mountain ridge & pine silhouettes",
    "  float ridge1 = -0.08 + 0.12 * abs(p.x) + 0.05 * sin(p.x * 7.0) + 0.02 * cos(p.x * 19.0);",
    "  float ridge2 = -0.18 + 0.08 * sin(p.x * 5.0 + 1.2) + 0.025 * sin(p.x * 42.0);",
    "  vec3 col = sky;",
    "  if(p.y < ridge1) col = vec3(0.012, 0.015, 0.028);",
    "  if(p.y < ridge2) col = vec3(0.018, 0.012, 0.010);",
    "  // Crossed glowing hearth logs at the base & volumetric campfire flames",
    "  float log1 = sdBox2(rot2(p - vec2(0.0, -0.38),  0.28), vec2(0.22, 0.028));",
    "  float log2 = sdBox2(rot2(p - vec2(0.0, -0.38), -0.28), vec2(0.22, 0.028));",
    "  float dLog = min(log1, log2);",
    "  if(dLog < 0.0){",
    "    float emberBark = fbm5(p * 28.0);",
    "    col = mix(vec3(0.06, 0.025, 0.01), vec3(1.15, 0.32, 0.04), smoothstep(0.45, 0.78, emberBark) * flicker);",
    "  }",
    "  float flame = fbm5(vec2(p.x * 5.0 + sin(p.y*6.0 + t*3.0)*0.22, p.y * 4.0 - t * 2.6));",
    "  float fMask = exp(-pow(p.x * 3.0, 2.0)) * exp(-max(p.y + 0.42, 0.0) * 3.2);",
    "  col += mix(vec3(1.15, 0.28, 0.04), vec3(1.30, 0.82, 0.24), flame) * flame * fMask * 1.15 * flicker;",
    "  for(int i=0; i<14; i++){",
    "    float fi = float(i);",
    "    float ey = mod(-0.45 + fi*0.11 + t*(0.28 + 0.12*h1(fi)), 1.05) - 0.50;",
    "    float ex = sin(ey * 6.5 + fi * 2.3 + t) * (0.10 + 0.20 * (ey + 0.50));",
    "    col += vec3(1.25, 0.55, 0.12) * exp(-length(p - vec2(ex, ey)) * 145.0);",
    "  }",
    "  wCol = col;",
    "  reveal = smoothstep(1.35, 2.50, t);",
    "}",
    "void main(){",
    "  vec2 p = (gl_FragCoord.xy - 0.5 * R) / R.y;",
    "  float A = R.x / R.y, t = T;",
    "  float impact = exp(-max(0.0, t - 1.700) * 14.0) * step(1.700, t);",
    "  vec2 shake = vec2(sin(t * 92.0), cos(t * 118.0)) * impact * 0.0065;",
    "  p += shake;",

    "// 12-Slice 3D Raymarched Parallax Extrusion + 12-Tap Volumetric God-Rays + Anamorphic Lens Flare + Shockwave",

    "// --- V6 FUTURISTIC HOLLYWOOD IMAX / THX 3D RAYMARCHED ARCHITECTURE & 12-SLICE EXTRUSION ENGINE ---",

    "// 12-Slice 3D Raymarched Parallax Extrusion + 12-Tap Volumetric God-Rays + Anamorphic Lens Flare + Shockwave",

    "float sdBox3(vec3 p, vec3 b){ vec3 d=abs(p)-b; return length(max(d,0.0))+min(max(d.x,max(d.y,d.z)),0.0); }",
    "vec3 aces(vec3 x){ return clamp((x*(2.51*x+0.03))/(x*(2.43*x+0.59)+0.14), 0.0, 1.0); }",
    "// Studio & Sanctuary IBL + Multi-Lobe Microfacet GGX BRDF (Dark base + 3-Dome Env Reflection + Rim Kicker)",
    "vec3 ggx(vec3 N, vec3 V, vec3 L, float rough, vec3 F0, vec3 diffAlb){",
    "  N = normalize(N); V = normalize(V); L = normalize(L);",
    "  vec3 H = normalize(V + L);",
    "  float NdotL = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);",
    "  float NdotV = max(dot(N, V), 0.001);",
    "  float NdotH = max(dot(N, H), 0.0);",
    "  float VdotH = max(dot(V, H), 0.0);",
    "  float a = max(rough * rough, 0.004); float a2 = a * a;",
    "  float d = (NdotH * a2 - NdotH) * NdotH + 1.0;",
    "  float D = a2 / (3.14159265 * d * d + 1e-5);",
    "  vec3 F = F0 + (1.0 - F0) * pow(clamp(1.0 - VdotH, 0.0, 1.0), 5.0);",
    "  float k = (rough + 1.0) * (rough + 1.0) * 0.125;",
    "  float G = (NdotV / (NdotV * (1.0 - k) + k)) * (NdotL / (NdotL * (1.0 - k) + k));",
    "  vec3 spec = (D * F * G) / (4.0 * NdotV * NdotL + 0.001) * NdotL;",
    "  vec3 diff = diffAlb * (1.0 - F) * (0.35 + 0.65 * NdotL);",
    "  // 3D Studio PMREM-Style Environment Reflection (Overhead Softbox + Key Strip + Horizon Rim)",
    "  vec3 R = reflect(-V, N);",
    "  float softbox = smoothstep(-0.2, 0.85, R.y) * (0.55 + 0.45 * cos(R.x * 3.5));",
    "  float keyStrip = exp(-length(R.xy - L.xy * 0.65) * 2.4);",
    "  float rimKick = pow(1.0 - NdotV, 2.6);",
    "  vec3 envLight = F0 * (0.28 * softbox + 0.52 * keyStrip + 0.25 * rimKick) * (1.0 - rough * 0.52);",
    "  return diff + spec * 1.15 + envLight;",
    "}",
    "// --- V6 FUTURISTIC HOLLYWOOD IMAX / THX 3D RAYMARCHED ARCHITECTURE & 12-SLICE EXTRUSION ENGINE ---",
    "vec3 world3DPass(vec2 p, float t, vec3 wCol, vec3 F0, vec3 subCol, float archMode){",
    "  float tImp = 1.65;",
    "  float dolly = t * 1.35 + smoothstep(tImp - 0.15, tImp + 0.35, t) * 0.65;",
    "  float roll = 0.035 * sin(t * 0.55) + 0.022 * exp(-max(0.0, t - tImp) * 5.0) * sin((t - tImp) * 32.0);",
    "  vec2 q = rot2(p, roll);",
    "  vec3 ro = vec3(0.10 * sin(t * 0.42), 0.05 * cos(t * 0.36), dolly);",
    "  vec3 rd = normalize(vec3(q * 1.18, 1.42));",
    "  float totalD = 0.0, glowAcc = 0.0, edgeAcc = 0.0, hit = 0.0;",
    "  vec3 hitPos = ro;",
    "  for(int i = 0; i < 16; i++){",
    "    vec3 pos = ro + rd * totalD;",
    "    float d = 10.0;",
    "    if(archMode < 0.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos; rp.x = abs(rp.x) - 1.32; rp.z = mod(rp.z + 0.7, 1.4) - 0.7;",
    "      float cyl = length(rp.xz) - 0.23 + 0.018 * cos(atan(rp.z, rp.x) * 16.0);",
    "      float cap = max(abs(pos.y) - 0.76, length(rp.xz) - 0.33);",
    "      float flCeil = 0.88 - abs(pos.y) + 0.025 * cos(pos.x * 8.0) * cos(pos.z * 8.0);",
    "      d = min(min(cyl, cap), flCeil);",
    "    } else if(archMode < 1.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos; rp.x = abs(rp.x) - 1.26; rp.z = mod(rp.z + 0.8, 1.6) - 0.8;",
    "      float pillar = length(rp.xz) - 0.18 + 0.024 * cos(atan(rp.z, rp.x) * 8.0);",
    "      float archRib = abs(length(vec2(pos.x, pos.y + 0.34)) - 1.24) - 0.055 + 0.035 * abs(rp.z);",
    "      float vault = 1.04 - abs(pos.y) - 0.18 * abs(pos.x);",
    "      d = min(min(pillar, archRib), vault);",
    "    } else if(archMode < 2.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos;",
    "      float oct = max(abs(rp.x), abs(rp.y)) * 0.82 + length(rp.xy) * 0.35;",
    "      float tunnel = 1.34 - oct;",
    "      float ribs = abs(mod(rp.z + 0.45, 0.9) - 0.45) - 0.045;",
    "      float trench = max(tunnel - 0.14, -ribs);",
    "      float laserB = length(vec2(abs(rp.x) - 0.94, abs(rp.y) - 0.54)) - 0.024;",
    "      glowAcc += 0.012 / (0.016 + max(0.0, laserB * laserB));",
    "      d = min(trench, laserB);",
    "    } else if(archMode < 3.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos; rp.xy = rot2(rp.xy, 0.16 * floor(rp.z * 0.8));",
    "      rp.x = abs(rp.x) - 1.20; rp.z = mod(rp.z + 0.65, 1.3) - 0.65;",
    "      float hexP = max(abs(rp.x) * 0.866 + abs(rp.z) * 0.5, abs(rp.z)) - 0.25 + 0.07 * rp.y;",
    "      float cavern = 0.96 - abs(pos.y) + 0.05 * sin(pos.x * 5.0 + pos.z * 3.0);",
    "      d = min(hexP, cavern);",
    "    } else if(archMode < 4.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos; rp.z = mod(rp.z + 0.9, 1.8) - 0.9;",
    "      float r = length(rp.xy);",
    "      float ang = atan(rp.y, rp.x) + t * 0.25 * (pos.z > 0.0 ? 1.0 : -1.0);",
    "      float gearR = max(abs(r - 1.20) - 0.13 + 0.042 * smoothstep(-0.2, 0.2, cos(ang * 24.0)), abs(rp.z) - 0.08);",
    "      float wall = 1.52 - r;",
    "      glowAcc += 0.008 / (0.02 + abs(r - 1.16) + abs(rp.z));",
    "      d = min(gearR, wall);",
    "    } else {",
    "      vec3 rp = pos;",
    "      float r = length(rp.xy + vec2(0.0, 1.62));",
    "      float ringD = abs(r - 2.32) - 0.08 + 0.02 * sin(rp.x * 12.0) * sin(rp.z * 12.0);",
    "      float struts = max(abs(abs(rp.x) - 1.32) - 0.08, abs(mod(rp.z + 0.6, 1.2) - 0.6) - 0.08);",
    "      glowAcc += 0.010 / (0.02 + abs(pos.y + 0.42) + abs(abs(pos.x) - 1.12));",
    "      d = min(ringD, struts);",
    "    }",
    "    if(d < 0.012){ hit = 1.0; hitPos = pos; break; }",
    "    edgeAcc += 0.016 / (0.04 + d * d * 6.0);",
    "    totalD += d * 0.72;",
    "    if(totalD > 8.5) break;",
    "  }",
    "  float fog = exp(-totalD * 0.28);",
    "  vec3 archCol = mix(wCol * 0.45, F0 * 0.28 + subCol * 0.35, (1.0 - fog) * 0.55);",
    "  if(hit > 0.5){",
    "    float stripe = 0.5 + 0.5 * cos(hitPos.z * 14.0) * cos(hitPos.x * 10.0);",
    "    float spec = pow(max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(hitPos.y) * 0.75), 4.0) * (0.4 + 0.6 * stripe);",
    "    archCol = mix(archCol, F0 * (0.28 + 0.52 * spec) + subCol * 0.35, fog * 0.68);",
    "  }",
    "  archCol += F0 * edgeAcc * 0.14 + (F0 * 0.7 + vec3(0.35, 0.65, 1.0) * 0.3) * glowAcc * 0.24;",
    "  return mix(wCol, archCol + wCol * 0.68, 0.46);",
    "}",
    "// 12-Slice 3D Raymarched Parallax Extrusion + 12-Tap Volumetric God-Rays + Anamorphic Lens Flare + Shockwave",
    "vec3 integrateWorldTypography(vec3 wColOrig, vec2 p, vec2 sc, vec2 hs, vec3 keyL, vec3 F0, vec3 baseAlb, vec3 subCol, float lRough, float reveal, float layoutMode){",
    "  float tImp = 1.65;",
    "  vec3 wCol = world3DPass(p, T, wColOrig, F0, subCol, mod(layoutMode + floor(F0.r * 7.0), 6.0));",
    "  // 1. 3D Perspective Camera Tilt, Dolly Zoom & Refractive Impact Shockwave",
    "  float impKick = exp(-max(0.0, T - tImp) * 4.2) * step(tImp, T);",
    "  float shockT = max(0.0, T - tImp);",
    "  float shockRing = exp(-pow((length(p - sc) - shockT * 1.65) * 9.5, 2.0)) * exp(-shockT * 1.9) * step(0.001, shockT);",
    "  vec2 qLocal = p - sc + normalize(p - sc + vec2(1e-5)) * shockRing * 0.026;",
    "  vec2 camTilt = vec2(0.22 * sin(T * 0.62), 0.14 * cos(T * 0.48)) * (1.0 - 0.62 * smoothstep(tImp, tImp + 1.35, T));",
    "  float perspZ = 1.0 + dot(qLocal, camTilt) * 0.44;",
    "  float zoom3D = mix(1.16, 1.0, smoothstep(0.45, tImp + 0.35, T)) - 0.035 * impKick * cos((T - tImp) * 34.0);",
    "  vec2 q3D = (qLocal / max(0.55, perspZ)) * zoom3D;",
    "  vec2 uv = q3D / (hs * 2.0) + 0.5;",
    "  // Panavision Anamorphic Horizontal Lens Flare & Shockwave Glow across full viewport",
    "  float flareEnv = smoothstep(tImp - 0.30, tImp + 0.15, T) * (0.52 + 0.68 * exp(-max(0.0, T - tImp) * 1.6));",
    "  float streak1 = exp(-abs(p.y - sc.y - 0.015) * 44.0) * exp(-abs(p.x) * 1.10);",
    "  float streak2 = exp(-abs(p.y - sc.y + 0.075) * 68.0) * exp(-abs(p.x - 0.06) * 1.35);",
    "  vec3 anamorphic = (vec3(0.36, 0.74, 1.0) * 0.48 + F0 * 0.68) * (streak1 * 0.68 + streak2 * 0.42) * flareEnv;",
    "  float ghost = exp(-abs(length((p - sc) * vec2(0.72, 1.38) + vec2(0.16, -0.05)) - 0.26) * 28.0) * 0.22 * flareEnv;",
    "  wCol += anamorphic + F0 * ghost + (F0 * 0.8 + vec3(0.4, 0.7, 1.0) * 0.4) * shockRing * 0.75;",
    "  if(uv.x < -0.18 || uv.x > 1.18 || uv.y < -0.18 || uv.y > 1.18) return wCol;",
    "  vec2 flipUV = clamp(uv, 0.0, 1.0);",
    "  float inBounds = step(0.0, uv.x) * step(uv.x, 1.0) * step(0.0, uv.y) * step(uv.y, 1.0);",
    "  vec2 texel = vec2(1.0 / 1024.0, 1.0 / 768.0);",
    "  float hC = texture2D(TX, flipUV).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hR = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV + vec2(texel.x * 2.0, 0.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hL = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV - vec2(texel.x * 2.0, 0.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hU = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV + vec2(0.0, texel.y * 2.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hD = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV - vec2(0.0, texel.y * 2.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float core = texture2D(TX, flipUV).g * inBounds;",
    "  float waveMask = reveal;",
    "  float edgeGlow = 0.0;",
    "  if(layoutMode < 0.5){",
    "    float rU = length((uv - 0.5) * vec2(1.33, 1.0));",
    "    float front = reveal * 0.96;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.08, front - 0.04, rU) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = exp(-pow((rU - front) * 18.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else if(layoutMode < 1.5){",
    "    float front = mix(-0.1, 1.15, reveal);",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.08, front - 0.04, uv.x) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = exp(-pow((uv.x - front) * 20.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else if(layoutMode < 2.5){",
    "    float front = mix(-0.25, 1.25, reveal);",
    "    float coord = uv.x * 0.82 + (1.0 - uv.y) * 0.28;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.12, front - 0.06, coord) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = 1.25 * exp(-pow((coord - front) * 16.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else if(layoutMode < 4.5){",
    "    float rU = abs(uv.x - 0.5) * 1.45;",
    "    float front = reveal * 0.95;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.10, front - 0.06, rU) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = exp(-pow((rU - front) * 16.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else {",
    "    float rU = length((uv - 0.5) * vec2(1.25, 1.0));",
    "    float front = reveal * 0.95;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.10, front - 0.06, rU) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = 1.2 * exp(-pow((rU - front) * 16.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  }",
    "  float letterMask = smoothstep(0.14, 0.64, max(core, hC * 0.62)) * waveMask * inBounds;",
    "  // 2. 12-Slice 3D Raymarched Parallax Extrusion along Perspective View/Light Axis",
    "  vec2 extrudeDir = normalize((uv - 0.5) - keyL.xy * 0.28 + vec2(1e-4)) * (0.026 + 0.014 * (1.0 - reveal));",
    "  float sideMask = 0.0;",
    "  float sideDepth = 1.0;",
    "  for(int i = 1; i <= 12; i++){",
    "    float fi = float(i) / 12.0;",
    "    vec2 sUV = uv - extrudeDir * fi;",
    "    float sIn = step(0.0, sUV.x) * step(sUV.x, 1.0) * step(0.0, sUV.y) * step(sUV.y, 1.0);",
    "    vec4 sTex = texture2D(TX, clamp(sUV, 0.0, 1.0)) * sIn;",
    "    float sHit = smoothstep(0.18, 0.58, max(sTex.g, sTex.r * 0.58)) * waveMask;",
    "    if(sHit > 0.25 && sideMask < 0.5){ sideMask = sHit; sideDepth = fi; }",
    "  }",
    "  // 3. 12-Tap Volumetric God-Ray Occlusion Shafts bursting through the 3D Extruded Letters",
    "  vec2 lightUV = vec2(0.5 + keyL.x * 0.18, 0.5 + keyL.y * 0.16);",
    "  vec2 rayStep = (uv - lightUV) / 12.0;",
    "  vec2 rUV = uv;",
    "  float godRay = 0.0, rW = 1.0;",
    "  for(int i = 0; i < 12; i++){",
    "    rUV -= rayStep * 0.88;",
    "    float rIn = step(0.0, rUV.x) * step(rUV.x, 1.0) * step(0.0, rUV.y) * step(rUV.y, 1.0);",
    "    vec4 rT = texture2D(TX, clamp(rUV, 0.0, 1.0)) * rIn;",
    "    float rEdge = max(rT.g, rT.r * 0.7) * waveMask;",
    "    godRay += (rEdge * (1.0 - letterMask * 0.65) + 0.14 * exp(-length(rUV - lightUV) * 4.5)) * rW;",
    "    rW *= 0.86;",
    "  }",
    "  godRay = (godRay / 6.2) * smoothstep(0.25, 1.55, T) * (1.0 + 0.75 * impKick);",
    "  // 4. Deep 3D Contact Shadow & Planar Horizon Reflection",
    "  float shadow = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV - keyL.xy * 0.012, 0.0, 1.0)).r * waveMask * inBounds;",
    "  vec3 worldBed = wCol * (1.0 - 0.88 * clamp(hC * 1.75, 0.0, 1.0) * waveMask) * (1.0 - 0.74 * max(shadow, sideMask * 0.75) * (1.0 - core));",
    "  worldBed += (F0 * 0.75 + vec3(0.42, 0.72, 1.0) * 0.25) * godRay * 0.48;",
    "  if(abs(layoutMode - 5.0) < 0.4 && uv.y < 0.44 && inBounds > 0.5){",
    "    float dy = 0.44 - uv.y;",
    "    float ripX = sin(dy * 95.0 - T * 4.5) * 0.008 * (0.4 + dy * 2.0);",
    "    vec2 refUV = vec2(clamp(uv.x + ripX, 0.0, 1.0), clamp(0.44 + dy * 1.05, 0.0, 1.0));",
    "    float rCore = texture2D(TX, refUV).g * waveMask;",
    "    worldBed += F0 * rCore * exp(-dy * 4.8) * 0.48;",
    "  }",
    "  // 5. Shade the 3D Extruded Metallic Side-Walls with Brushed Anisotropy + Rim Specular",
    "  vec3 V = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);",
    "  vec3 L = normalize(keyL + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.45));",
    "  vec3 fillL = normalize(vec3(-L.x * 0.85, -L.y * 0.55 + 0.32, 0.72));",
    "  float onlySide = clamp(sideMask * (1.0 - letterMask * 0.96), 0.0, 1.0);",
    "  if(onlySide > 0.001){",
    "    vec2 sTang = normalize(extrudeDir + vec2(1e-5));",
    "    vec3 sideN = normalize(vec3(sTang.x * 0.86, sTang.y * 0.86, 0.50));",
    "    float brushed = 0.72 + 0.28 * sin(sideDepth * 42.0 + uv.x * 60.0);",
    "    float sideAtten = (1.0 - 0.55 * sideDepth) * brushed;",
    "    vec3 sideCol = ggx(sideN, V, L, lRough + 0.06, F0 * 0.88, baseAlb * 0.7) * 1.65 * sideAtten;",
    "    sideCol += F0 * pow(1.0 - sideDepth, 2.2) * 0.38;",
    "    worldBed = mix(worldBed, sideCol, onlySide);",
    "  }",
    "  // 6. Shade the Diamond-Cut Beveled Front Face",
    "  vec3 N = normalize(vec3((hL - hR) * 5.2, (hD - hU) * 5.2, 0.26));",
    "  vec3 metalCol = ggx(N, V, L, lRough, F0, baseAlb) + ggx(N, V, fillL, lRough + 0.06, F0 * 0.92, baseAlb) * 0.52;",
    "  float sweepPos = mix(-0.85, 0.85, clamp((T - 1.50) / 1.95, 0.0, 1.0));",
    "  float sweep = exp(-pow((uv.x - 0.5 - sweepPos * 0.65 + (uv.y - 0.5)*0.22) * 7.5, 2.0)) * smoothstep(1.30, 1.90, T);",
    "  metalCol += F0 * (0.30 + 1.45 * sweep + 1.55 * edgeGlow);",
    "  return mix(worldBed, metalCol, clamp(letterMask, 0.0, 1.0));",
    "}",
    "void sceneWorld(vec2 p, vec3 ro, vec3 rd, float t, float A, vec4 U0, vec4 U1, out vec3 wCol, out float reveal, out vec3 keyL){",
    "// High-voltage neon ballast ignition flicker at t = 0.4..1.65s",
    "float ign = smoothstep(0.25, 1.65, t) * (0.75 + 0.25 * step(0.15, fract(sin(floor(t*22.0)*91.7)*43758.5)));",
    "keyL = normalize(vec3(sin(t*1.2)*0.55, 0.45, 0.70));",
    "",
    "vec3 col = vec3(0.012, 0.010, 0.026);",
    "// 3D Wet-Asphalt Planar Perspective Reflection below horizon",
    "if(p.y < -0.18){",
    "float z = -0.26 / min(p.y + 0.16, -0.02);",
    "vec2 wp = vec2(p.x * z, z + t * 0.8);",
    "float ripple = sin(wp.x * 14.0 + fbm3(wp * 3.5)*4.0) * 0.03;",
    "float neonReflM = exp(-abs(p.x + ripple - 0.22)*5.5);",
    "float neonReflC = exp(-abs(p.x + ripple + 0.22)*5.5);",
    "col += (vec3(1.1, 0.12, 0.55)*neonReflM + vec3(0.08, 0.85, 1.1)*neonReflC) * ign * exp(-z*0.18) * 0.55;",
    "}",
    "// Glowing 3D Neon Glass Tubes framing the window",
    "float dTubeOut = abs(sdBox2(p - vec2(0.0, U0.w), U0.xy + vec2(0.04, 0.035))) - 0.006;",
    "float dTubeIn  = abs(sdBox2(p - vec2(0.0, U0.w), U0.xy + vec2(0.018, 0.015))) - 0.004;",
    "col += vec3(1.2, 0.15, 0.62) * exp(-max(dTubeOut, 0.0) * 65.0) * ign * 0.65;",
    "col += vec3(0.12, 0.92, 1.25) * exp(-max(dTubeIn, 0.0) * 85.0) * ign * 0.55;",
    "",
    "// 3D Bi-Metallic Cyber Medallion",
    "",
    "// Volumetric Sanctuary Zenith Light Cone & Depth-of-Field Atmospheric Bokeh",
    "wCol = col;",
    "reveal = smoothstep(1.35, 2.45, t);",
    "}",
    "void main(){",
    "  vec2 p = (gl_FragCoord.xy - 0.5 * R) / R.y;",
    "  float A = R.x / R.y, t = T;",
    "  float impact = exp(-max(0.0, t - 1.650) * 14.0) * step(1.650, t);",
    "  vec2 shake = vec2(sin(t * 92.0), cos(t * 118.0)) * impact * 0.0065;",
    "  p += shake;",
    "  vec2 hs = U0.xy, sc = vec2(0.0, U0.w);",
    "  float dolly = mix(1.22, 1.0, smoothstep(0.0, 3.6, t));",
    "  vec3 ro = vec3(sin(t * 0.35) * 0.035, cos(t * 0.28) * 0.025, -2.15 * dolly);",
    "  vec3 rd = normalize(vec3(p * dolly, 1.35));",
    "  vec3 wCol = vec3(0.0); float reveal = 0.0; vec3 keyL = normalize(vec3(0.42, 0.58, 0.70));",
    "  sceneWorld(p, ro, rd, t, A, U0, U1, wCol, reveal, keyL);",
    "  vec3 col = integrateWorldTypography(wCol, p, sc, hs, keyL, vec3(0.950,0.350,0.850), vec3(0.040,0.080,0.140), vec3(0.030,0.040,0.080), 0.120, reveal, 6.0);",

    "float sdBox2(vec2 p, vec2 b){ vec2 d=abs(p)-b; return length(max(d,0.0))+min(max(d.x,d.y),0.0); }",

    "vec3 aces(vec3 x){ return clamp((x*(2.51*x+0.03))/(x*(2.43*x+0.59)+0.14), 0.0, 1.0); }",
    "// Studio & Sanctuary IBL + Multi-Lobe Microfacet GGX BRDF (Dark base + 3-Dome Env Reflection + Rim Kicker)",
    "vec3 ggx(vec3 N, vec3 V, vec3 L, float rough, vec3 F0, vec3 diffAlb){",
    "  N = normalize(N); V = normalize(V); L = normalize(L);",
    "  vec3 H = normalize(V + L);",
    "  float NdotL = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);",
    "  float NdotV = max(dot(N, V), 0.001);",
    "  float NdotH = max(dot(N, H), 0.0);",
    "  float VdotH = max(dot(V, H), 0.0);",
    "  float a = max(rough * rough, 0.004); float a2 = a * a;",
    "  float d = (NdotH * a2 - NdotH) * NdotH + 1.0;",
    "  float D = a2 / (3.14159265 * d * d + 1e-5);",
    "  vec3 F = F0 + (1.0 - F0) * pow(clamp(1.0 - VdotH, 0.0, 1.0), 5.0);",
    "  float k = (rough + 1.0) * (rough + 1.0) * 0.125;",
    "  float G = (NdotV / (NdotV * (1.0 - k) + k)) * (NdotL / (NdotL * (1.0 - k) + k));",
    "  vec3 spec = (D * F * G) / (4.0 * NdotV * NdotL + 0.001) * NdotL;",
    "  vec3 diff = diffAlb * (1.0 - F) * (0.35 + 0.65 * NdotL);",
    "  // 3D Studio PMREM-Style Environment Reflection (Overhead Softbox + Key Strip + Horizon Rim)",
    "  vec3 R = reflect(-V, N);",
    "  float softbox = smoothstep(-0.2, 0.85, R.y) * (0.55 + 0.45 * cos(R.x * 3.5));",
    "  float keyStrip = exp(-length(R.xy - L.xy * 0.65) * 2.4);",
    "  float rimKick = pow(1.0 - NdotV, 2.6);",
    "  vec3 envLight = F0 * (0.28 * softbox + 0.52 * keyStrip + 0.25 * rimKick) * (1.0 - rough * 0.52);",
    "  return diff + spec * 1.15 + envLight;",
    "}",
    "// --- V6 FUTURISTIC HOLLYWOOD IMAX / THX 3D RAYMARCHED ARCHITECTURE & 12-SLICE EXTRUSION ENGINE ---",
    "vec3 world3DPass(vec2 p, float t, vec3 wCol, vec3 F0, vec3 subCol, float archMode){",
    "  float tImp = 1.65;",
    "  float dolly = t * 1.35 + smoothstep(tImp - 0.15, tImp + 0.35, t) * 0.65;",
    "  float roll = 0.035 * sin(t * 0.55) + 0.022 * exp(-max(0.0, t - tImp) * 5.0) * sin((t - tImp) * 32.0);",
    "  vec2 q = rot2(p, roll);",

    "    float d = 10.0;",
    "    if(archMode < 0.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos; rp.x = abs(rp.x) - 1.32; rp.z = mod(rp.z + 0.7, 1.4) - 0.7;",
    "      float cyl = length(rp.xz) - 0.23 + 0.018 * cos(atan(rp.z, rp.x) * 16.0);",

    "      float hexP = max(abs(rp.x) * 0.866 + abs(rp.z) * 0.5, abs(rp.z)) - 0.25 + 0.07 * rp.y;",
    "      float cavern = 0.96 - abs(pos.y) + 0.05 * sin(pos.x * 5.0 + pos.z * 3.0);",

    "    } else if(archMode < 4.5){",
    "      vec3 rp = pos; rp.z = mod(rp.z + 0.9, 1.8) - 0.9;",

    "      float wall = 1.52 - r;",
    "      glowAcc += 0.008 / (0.02 + abs(r - 1.16) + abs(rp.z));",
    "      d = min(gearR, wall);",
    "    } else {",
    "      vec3 rp = pos;",
    "      float r = length(rp.xy + vec2(0.0, 1.62));",
    "      float ringD = abs(r - 2.32) - 0.08 + 0.02 * sin(rp.x * 12.0) * sin(rp.z * 12.0);",
    "      float struts = max(abs(abs(rp.x) - 1.32) - 0.08, abs(mod(rp.z + 0.6, 1.2) - 0.6) - 0.08);",
    "      glowAcc += 0.010 / (0.02 + abs(pos.y + 0.42) + abs(abs(pos.x) - 1.12));",
    "      d = min(ringD, struts);",
    "    }",
    "    if(d < 0.012){ hit = 1.0; hitPos = pos; break; }",
    "    edgeAcc += 0.016 / (0.04 + d * d * 6.0);",
    "    totalD += d * 0.72;",
    "    if(totalD > 8.5) break;",
    "  }",
    "  float fog = exp(-totalD * 0.28);",
    "  vec3 archCol = mix(wCol * 0.45, F0 * 0.28 + subCol * 0.35, (1.0 - fog) * 0.55);",
    "  if(hit > 0.5){",
    "    float stripe = 0.5 + 0.5 * cos(hitPos.z * 14.0) * cos(hitPos.x * 10.0);",
    "    float spec = pow(max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(hitPos.y) * 0.75), 4.0) * (0.4 + 0.6 * stripe);",
    "    archCol = mix(archCol, F0 * (0.28 + 0.52 * spec) + subCol * 0.35, fog * 0.68);",

    "  archCol += F0 * edgeAcc * 0.14 + (F0 * 0.7 + vec3(0.35, 0.65, 1.0) * 0.3) * glowAcc * 0.24;",
    "  return mix(wCol, archCol + wCol * 0.68, 0.46);",
    "}",
    "// 12-Slice 3D Raymarched Parallax Extrusion + 12-Tap Volumetric God-Rays + Anamorphic Lens Flare + Shockwave",
    "vec3 integrateWorldTypography(vec3 wColOrig, vec2 p, vec2 sc, vec2 hs, vec3 keyL, vec3 F0, vec3 baseAlb, vec3 subCol, float lRough, float reveal, float layoutMode){",
    "  float tImp = 1.65;",
    "  vec3 wCol = world3DPass(p, T, wColOrig, F0, subCol, mod(layoutMode + floor(F0.r * 7.0), 6.0));",
    "  // 1. 3D Perspective Camera Tilt, Dolly Zoom & Refractive Impact Shockwave",
    "  float impKick = exp(-max(0.0, T - tImp) * 4.2) * step(tImp, T);",
    "  float shockT = max(0.0, T - tImp);",
    "  float shockRing = exp(-pow((length(p - sc) - shockT * 1.65) * 9.5, 2.0)) * exp(-shockT * 1.9) * step(0.001, shockT);",
    "  vec2 qLocal = p - sc + normalize(p - sc + vec2(1e-5)) * shockRing * 0.026;",
    "  vec2 camTilt = vec2(0.22 * sin(T * 0.62), 0.14 * cos(T * 0.48)) * (1.0 - 0.62 * smoothstep(tImp, tImp + 1.35, T));",
    "  float perspZ = 1.0 + dot(qLocal, camTilt) * 0.44;",

    "  vec2 q3D = (qLocal / max(0.55, perspZ)) * zoom3D;",
    "  vec2 uv = q3D / (hs * 2.0) + 0.5;",
    "  // Panavision Anamorphic Horizontal Lens Flare & Shockwave Glow across full viewport",
    "  float flareEnv = smoothstep(tImp - 0.30, tImp + 0.15, T) * (0.52 + 0.68 * exp(-max(0.0, T - tImp) * 1.6));",
    "  float streak1 = exp(-abs(p.y - sc.y - 0.015) * 44.0) * exp(-abs(p.x) * 1.10);",
    "  float streak2 = exp(-abs(p.y - sc.y + 0.075) * 68.0) * exp(-abs(p.x - 0.06) * 1.35);",
    "  vec3 anamorphic = (vec3(0.36, 0.74, 1.0) * 0.48 + F0 * 0.68) * (streak1 * 0.68 + streak2 * 0.42) * flareEnv;",
    "  float ghost = exp(-abs(length((p - sc) * vec2(0.72, 1.38) + vec2(0.16, -0.05)) - 0.26) * 28.0) * 0.22 * flareEnv;",
    "  wCol += anamorphic + F0 * ghost + (F0 * 0.8 + vec3(0.4, 0.7, 1.0) * 0.4) * shockRing * 0.75;",
    "  if(uv.x < -0.18 || uv.x > 1.18 || uv.y < -0.18 || uv.y > 1.18) return wCol;",
    "  vec2 flipUV = clamp(uv, 0.0, 1.0);",
    "  float inBounds = step(0.0, uv.x) * step(uv.x, 1.0) * step(0.0, uv.y) * step(uv.y, 1.0);",
    "  vec2 texel = vec2(1.0 / 1024.0, 1.0 / 768.0);",
    "  float hC = texture2D(TX, flipUV).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hR = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV + vec2(texel.x * 2.0, 0.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hL = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV - vec2(texel.x * 2.0, 0.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hU = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV + vec2(0.0, texel.y * 2.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float hD = texture2D(TX, clamp(flipUV - vec2(0.0, texel.y * 2.0), 0.0, 1.0)).r * inBounds;",
    "  float core = texture2D(TX, flipUV).g * inBounds;",
    "  float waveMask = reveal;",
    "  float edgeGlow = 0.0;",
    "  if(layoutMode < 0.5){",
    "    float rU = length((uv - 0.5) * vec2(1.33, 1.0));",
    "    float front = reveal * 0.96;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.08, front - 0.04, rU) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = exp(-pow((rU - front) * 18.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else if(layoutMode < 1.5){",
    "    float front = mix(-0.1, 1.15, reveal);",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.08, front - 0.04, uv.x) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = exp(-pow((uv.x - front) * 20.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else if(layoutMode < 2.5){",
    "    float front = mix(-0.25, 1.25, reveal);",
    "    float coord = uv.x * 0.82 + (1.0 - uv.y) * 0.28;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.12, front - 0.06, coord) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = 1.25 * exp(-pow((coord - front) * 16.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else if(layoutMode < 4.5){",
    "    float rU = abs(uv.x - 0.5) * 1.45;",
    "    float front = reveal * 0.95;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.10, front - 0.06, rU) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = exp(-pow((rU - front) * 16.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  } else {",
    "    float rU = length((uv - 0.5) * vec2(1.25, 1.0));",
    "    float front = reveal * 0.95;",
    "    waveMask = smoothstep(front + 0.10, front - 0.06, rU) * step(0.01, reveal);",
    "    edgeGlow = 1.2 * exp(-pow((rU - front) * 16.0, 2.0)) * step(0.02, reveal) * step(reveal, 0.98);",
    "  }",
    "  float letterMask = smoothstep(0.14, 0.64, max(core, hC * 0.62)) * waveMask * inBounds;",
    "  // 2. 12-Slice 3D Raymarched Parallax Extrusion along Perspective View/Light Axis",

    "    vec4 sTex = texture2D(TX, clamp(sUV, 0.0, 1.0)) * sIn;",
    "    float sHit = smoothstep(0.18, 0.58, max(sTex.g, sTex.r * 0.58)) * waveMask;",

    "  }",
    "  // 3. 12-Tap Volumetric God-Ray Occlusion Shafts bursting through the 3D Extruded Letters",
    "  vec2 lightUV = vec2(0.5 + keyL.x * 0.18, 0.5 + keyL.y * 0.16);",

    "  vec2 rUV = uv;",
    "  float godRay = 0.0, rW = 1.0;",
    "  for(int i = 0; i < 12; i++){",
    "    rUV -= rayStep * 0.88;",
    "    float rIn = step(0.0, rUV.x) * step(rUV.x, 1.0) * step(0.0, rUV.y) * step(rUV.y, 1.0);",
    "    vec4 rT = texture2D(TX, clamp(rUV, 0.0, 1.0)) * rIn;",
    "    float rEdge = max(rT.g, rT.r * 0.7) * waveMask;",

    "    rW *= 0.86;",
    "  }",
    "  godRay = (godRay / 6.2) * smoothstep(0.25, 1.55, T) * (1.0 + 0.75 * impKick);",
    "  // 4. Deep 3D Contact Shadow & Planar Horizon Reflection",

    "  vec3 worldBed = wCol * (1.0 - 0.88 * clamp(hC * 1.75, 0.0, 1.0) * waveMask) * (1.0 - 0.74 * max(shadow, sideMask * 0.75) * (1.0 - core));",
    "  worldBed += (F0 * 0.75 + vec3(0.42, 0.72, 1.0) * 0.25) * godRay * 0.48;",
    "  if(abs(layoutMode - 5.0) < 0.4 && uv.y < 0.44 && inBounds > 0.5){",
    "    float dy = 0.44 - uv.y;",
    "    float ripX = sin(dy * 95.0 - T * 4.5) * 0.008 * (0.4 + dy * 2.0);",
    "    vec2 refUV = vec2(clamp(uv.x + ripX, 0.0, 1.0), clamp(0.44 + dy * 1.05, 0.0, 1.0));",
    "    float rCore = texture2D(TX, refUV).g * waveMask;",
    "    worldBed += F0 * rCore * exp(-dy * 4.8) * 0.48;",
    "  }",
    "  // 5. Shade the 3D Extruded Metallic Side-Walls with Brushed Anisotropy + Rim Specular",
    "  vec3 V = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);",
    "  vec3 L = normalize(keyL + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.45));",
    "  vec3 fillL = normalize(vec3(-L.x * 0.85, -L.y * 0.55 + 0.32, 0.72));",
    "  float onlySide = clamp(sideMask * (1.0 - letterMask * 0.96), 0.0, 1.0);",
    "  if(onlySide > 0.001){",

    "    float brushed = 0.72 + 0.28 * sin(sideDepth * 42.0 + uv.x * 60.0);",

    "  }",
    "  // 6. Shade the Diamond-Cut Beveled Front Face",

    "  float sweepPos = mix(-0.85, 0.85, clamp((T - 1.50) / 1.95, 0.0, 1.0));",

    "void sceneWorld(vec2 p, vec3 ro, vec3 rd, float t, float A, vec4 U0, vec4 U1, out vec3 wCol, out float reveal, out vec3 keyL){",
    "keyL = normalize(vec3(sin(t*0.5)*0.35, 0.45, 0.82));",
    "float horY = -0.04;",
    "float ay = abs(p.y - horY);",
    "vec3 sky = mix(vec3(0.96, 0.62, 0.42), vec3(0.12, 0.22, 0.48), smoothstep(0.0, 0.48, ay));",
    "sky = mix(vec3(0.98, 0.84, 0.62), sky, smoothstep(0.0, 0.09, ay));",
    "vec3 col = sky * 0.72;",
    "if(p.y < horY){",
    "float z = 0.28 / max(horY - p.y, 0.015);",
    "vec2 sp = vec2(p.x * z, z + t * 0.25);",
    "vec2 cell = fract(sp * 1.4) - 0.5;",
    "float ridge = smoothstep(0.04, 0.0, 0.5 - max(abs(cell.x), abs(cell.y)));",
    "float rip = sin(length(p - vec2(0.0, horY - 0.12))*48.0 - t*5.0) * exp(-length(p)*3.0) * 0.015;",
    "float fres = 0.25 + 0.75 * pow(1.0 - clamp((horY - p.y)*2.2, 0.0, 1.0), 4.0);",
    "col = mix(vec3(0.18, 0.20, 0.26), sky * 0.85, fres) + vec3(0.75, 0.78, 0.85) * ridge * exp(-z*0.25) * 0.35 + rip;",
    "}",
    "// Expanding Footstep Ripple Ring & Planar Horizon Mirror Doubling the Altiplano Sky",
    "float stepT = max(0.0, t - 0.35);",
    "vec2 stepOrigin = vec2(0.0, horY - 0.10);",

    "// Inverted Mirror Reflection of TITAN RELIQUARY in the flooded brine below horY",
    "if(p.y < horY && t > 1.35){",
    "vec2 reflUV = (vec2(p.x, (horY - p.y) * 1.15 - 0.02) - vec2(0.0, U0.w)) / (U0.xy * 2.0) + 0.5;",

    "// 12-Slice 3D Raymarched Parallax Extrusion + 12-Tap Volumetric God-Rays + Anamorphic Lens Flare + Shockwave",
